policy: This POC loads no generative language model, with one narrow, bounded exception recorded in FORBIDDEN.md: a small local FLAN-T5/T5 checkpoint, rewriter role only, fidelity-gated. See bounded_rewriter_exception below. Every other component stays non-generative.

substitutes.embeddings: sklearn TfidfVectorizer cosine (in place of bge-small-en-v1.5)
substitutes.sparse_retrieval: in-process Okapi BM25 (in place of Qdrant sparse / SPLADE)
substitutes.reranker: lexical coverage cross-score (in place of bge-reranker-v2-m3)
substitutes.ask_classifier: feature rules (in place of zero-shot DeBERTa NLI)
substitutes.entity_tagging: rule tagger plus a stricter second rule tagger (in place of GLiNER and dslim/bert-base-NER)
substitutes.address_parsing: regex field parser (in place of libpostal)
substitutes.extractive_qa: two lexical span extractors (in place of DeBERTa/RoBERTa SQuAD2)
substitutes.nli: polarity, number, and coverage judge (in place of DeBERTa-v3 MNLI)
substitutes.pair_matcher: logistic regression over string and context features
substitutes.rewriter: deterministic assembly of verified findings is still the default and the fallback; a small local FLAN-T5/T5 checkpoint is allowed only under the bounded_rewriter_exception below, and only once it has actually been loaded and measured
substitutes.proposer: not used; template analyzer plus grounding filter only

bounded_rewriter_exception.status: policy change recorded 2026-10-14 in FORBIDDEN.md (flan-t5-small); widened 2026-10-15 for gemma3:270m via Ollama; widened again 2026-10-16 for a community legal/financial fine-tune of gemma3:270m, all measured side by side rather than one replacing another
allowed_checkpoints: flan-t5-small (or comparably small T5, under ~300M params) -- implemented and measured: EXP-048/054/056/062
gemma3:270m via Ollama (or comparably small Gemma 3, under ~300M params) -- implemented and measured: EXP-063/064
nagbhaskar55/gemma-3-270m-bhaskar-finetune (base google/gemma-3-270m-it, 268M params, via transformers, not Ollama) -- permitted 2026-10-16, measured: EXP-076
bounded_rewriter_exception.allowed_role: rewriter only (ARCHITECTURE.md section 3.7): join and grammar-correct already-verified findings into prose
bounded_rewriter_exception.still_forbidden_for_this_checkpoint: proposer role, extraction, answering, support/contradiction judging, any role that could assert a new fact -- applies equally to all permitted checkpoints
bounded_rewriter_exception.ollama_scope: Ollama is permitted only to run gemma3:270m in the rewriter role, fully local -- not as a general local LLM runtime, not for any other checkpoint, not against a remote host. See FORBIDDEN.md.
bounded_rewriter_exception.implementation: lab/common/rewriter_backends.py is the model-agnostic dispatcher (added 2026-10-16): one generate(checkpoint, prompt, max_tokens) entry point and one rewrite_unit built on the shared build_prompt/fidelity_gate from lab/common/real_rewriter.py. lab/common/real_rewriter.py (flan-t5-small) and lab/common/real_rewriter_ollama.py (gemma3:270m, plus its citation-splice and decoding-constrained variants) remain the per-checkpoint generation backends rewriter_backends.py dispatches to; nothing in them changed.
bounded_rewriter_exception.measured_result_flan_t5_small: EXP-048, on 13 claim/paragraph findings also used by EXP-017: fidelity pass rate 0.0 at leaf size 4, rising to 0.3846 at leaf size 1 (EXP-054), unchanged by a more directive prompt (EXP-056) or by retry-with-feedback (EXP-062). flan-t5-small did not invent facts; its dominant failure mode was dropping content (collapsing to one finding, or to just the citation marker), not hallucination.
bounded_rewriter_exception.measured_result_gemma3_270m: EXP-063, on the identical 13 findings EXP-048/054/056/062 used, leaf size 1: raw fidelity pass rate 0.0, but content was preserved verbatim in every case -- the failure was a citation-formatting gap, not content loss. A narrow, content-safe repair (append the missing citation only when it is the sole gap, rechecked through the full gate) raised this to 0.8462. EXP-064 then replaced that post-hoc repair with a real decoding-level constraint (Ollama's JSON-schema structured output: a non-empty-content field and an enum-constrained citation field, making both grammar-level impossible to violate) and reached 1.0 -- all 13 leaves faithful, including the two cases (one prior empty-output collapse, one prior dropped number) that survived the post-hoc splice unfixed.
bounded_rewriter_exception.measured_result_bhaskar_finetune: see EXP-076's results.json once run -- filled in after measurement, not assumed from the model card's own self-reported perplexity numbers.
bounded_rewriter_exception.required_guardrail: every rewrite must pass the fidelity check (numbers/dates/names preserved, modals unchanged, bidirectional entailment, citations preserved) or fall back to the unchanged lab/common/assemble.py output -- for every checkpoint

lora_fine_tuning.status: policy change recorded 2026-10-16 in FORBIDDEN.md -- offline LoRA adapter on one of the two allowed_checkpoints above, rewriter role only, not full fine-tuning, not a new role, not online/inference-time weight updates
lora_fine_tuning.why: EXP-048/054/056/062/064: every non-training approach tried (leaf decomposition, a more directive prompt, retry-with-feedback, decoding-level JSON-schema constraints) left multi-fact-leaf synthesis (joining several findings into one leaf without dropping any) unsolved. This is the one untried direction the project's own deep-research report recommended first.
lora_fine_tuning.checkpoint_used: flan-t5-small, not gemma3:270m -- google/gemma-3-270m on HuggingFace is gate-restricted (manual license acceptance) and this environment has no HF credentials that have accepted it; no workaround was attempted. flan-t5-small is the original bounded-rewriter checkpoint, ungated, and already has the identical failure measured on it (EXP-048/054/056/062), so it tests the same question, not a different one. Retry with gemma3:270m if HF access is ever obtained.
lora_fine_tuning.training_data: deterministically generated synthetic DiscoFuse-style examples ('combine these N verified findings into one sentence, keep every one'), generated by code in this repo and checked into data/ -- never scraped, never real documents.
lora_fine_tuning.method: LoRA adapter (peft) on flan-t5-small's frozen base weights, trained offline as its own exploration with a held-out eval split and a frozen result -- not a weight update made while answering a question (see FORBIDDEN.md's 'No weight updates at inference time').
lora_fine_tuning.measured_result: see EXP-072's results.json once run -- filled in after training, not assumed beforehand.
lora_fine_tuning.required_guardrail: same fidelity gate as the base exception; adopted only if it measurably improves the 4-fact-leaf fidelity pass rate over the unmodified checkpoint on held-out cases, otherwise the base checkpoint remains the only path (FORBIDDEN.md's reversibility clause).

real_model_reruns.note: EXP-025, EXP-029, EXP-032, EXP-033: spaCy real-pretrained substitutes, from when huggingface.co was blocked (see spaCy sub-block below). EXP-030, EXP-031, EXP-038, EXP-039, EXP-040, EXP-042: the actual blueprint checkpoints, loaded directly, now that huggingface.co is reachable from this machine. Every other exploration still runs the classical substitutes in 'substitutes'.
real_model_reruns.huggingface_co_reachable_here: On this machine huggingface.co is reachable (unlike the earlier cloud sandbox this project started in), so bge-small-en-v1.5, deepset/deberta-v3-base-squad2, and MoritzLaurer/DeBERTa-v3-base-mnli-fever-anli are loaded directly. See lab/common/real_encoders.py.

real_blueprint_checkpoints_loaded.bge-small-en-v1.5: dense retrieval leg, in place of TF-IDF cosine (EXP-040 paged retrieval, EXP-042 repetition detection); sentence-transformers, local, not an API call
real_blueprint_checkpoints_loaded.deepset/deberta-v3-base-squad2: extractive QA, in place of the lexical extractors (EXP-030, EXP-038, EXP-039); transformers, local, not an API call
real_blueprint_checkpoints_loaded.MoritzLaurer/DeBERTa-v3-base-mnli-fever-: NLI judge, in place of the lexical judge (EXP-031, EXP-041); transformers, local, not an API call
real_blueprint_checkpoints_loaded.dslim/bert-base-NER: named-entity tagging, in place of the rule tagger; loaded in lab/common/real_encoders.py but not yet wired into a closed exploration (EXP-034 needs more than a model swap, see below)
real_blueprint_checkpoints_loaded.gliner: named by the blueprint for NER alongside dslim/bert-base-NER; the `gliner` package is not installed in this environment, so GLiNER itself is not loaded -- dslim/bert-base-NER is the real checkpoint measured instead

real_model_reruns.entity_resolution_not_yet_rerun: EXP-034 (entity resolution with real NER + bge) is still todo: lab/common/entities.py's resolution loop is built around rule-tagger-specific labels (defined term, address, amount) that dslim/bert-base-NER's PER/ORG/LOC/MISC don't map onto directly, so this is a real integration task, not a drop-in swap.

spacy_substitutes_still_in_use.embeddings: spaCy en_core_web_md static word vectors (GloVe-style, real pretrained) in place of TF-IDF, for EXP-029 and EXP-032's dense retrieval leg -- not re-run with bge, since EXP-040/042 already measure bge directly on different fixtures
spacy_substitutes_still_in_use.entity_tagging: spaCy en_core_web_sm NER (CNN tagger trained on OntoNotes 5, real pretrained) in place of the rule tagger, for EXP-032 and EXP-033

real_model_reruns.not_the_blueprint_checkpoint: spaCy's pipelines are real, reachable, non-generative pretrained models, but they are not bge-small-en-v1.5, deepset/deberta-v3-base-squad2, or GLiNER. Do not cite EXP-029/032/033 numbers as bge, DeBERTa, or GLiNER results -- EXP-030/031/038/039/040/042 are the actual blueprint-checkpoint numbers.
